## Answers

**h01** — `s3presign.Runner` (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:16`, refreshes S3 presigned URLs on attachments so `reference` links don't expire) — every 12 hours (`runnerInterval = time.Hour * 12`, `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:28`; ticker loop `runner.go:30-40`), plus one immediate pass at boot — wired in `Server.startBackgroundRunners`: `server/server.go:162` (construct), `server/server.go:163` (`RunOnce`), `server/server.go:169` (`Run` goroutine), reached from `Server.Start` at `server/server.go:127`. Presign skip/renew threshold: 4 days of a 5-day expiry (`runner.go:88-94`).

**h02** — Delivery function: `webhook.Post` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120` (actual send at `webhook.go:152` via `safeClient.Do`); it runs on 4 background workers draining `asyncPostQueue` (`webhook.go:39-55`), fed by `webhook.PostAsync` (`webhook.go:184`). Protection: SSRF guard at dial time — `safeDialContext` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:59-77`) installed as the client's `Transport.DialContext` (`webhook.go:32-37`); it resolves the host and rejects reserved/private IPs via `isReservedIP`/`reservedCIDRs` (`internal/webhook/validate.go:14-54`), which also defeats DNS rebinding. Registration-time check: `webhook.ValidateURL` (`internal/webhook/validate.go:62`), called from `server/router/api/v1/user_service_webhooks.go:74`. Escape hatch: `webhook.AllowPrivateIPs` (`internal/webhook/validate.go:41`).

**h03** — Abstraction package: `internal/idp` (`internal/idp/idp.go:3` — `IdentityProviderUserInfo`, the common user-info shape). Implementation package: `internal/idp/oauth2` (`internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go:19` `IdentityProvider`, with `ExchangeToken` at `:47` and `UserInfo` at `:83`); constructed at `server/router/api/v1/auth_service_sso.go:121`. OAuth2 is the only concrete protocol shipped.

**h04** — **No.** `store/db/db.go` is the only file in the repo that imports `github.com/usememos/memos/store/db/mysql` (`store/db/db.go:8`), and `mysql.NewDB` has exactly one call site, `store/db/db.go:22`, inside the `switch profile.Driver` factory. `grep -rl "store/db/mysql" --include=*.go .` returns `store/db/db.go` only; `mysql.NewDB` is declared at `store/db/mysql/mysql.go:20` with no other callers (including tests).

**h05** — Explicit Go code, per driver, inside the delete-user transaction; there is no DB-level rule. Evidence:
- `store/db/sqlite/user_delete.go:96` + `:102` call `deleteReactionsByContentIDsTx` (`:380`, `DELETE FROM reaction WHERE content_id IN (...)`) and `deleteReactionsByCreatorTx` (`:400`, `DELETE FROM reaction WHERE creator_id = ?`).
- Same pair in `store/db/postgres/user_delete.go:96,102,380,400` and `store/db/mysql/user_delete.go:96,102,417,437`.
- Schema: `reaction` is declared with no foreign key / `ON DELETE` clause — `store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:92-99`, `store/migration/postgres/LATEST.sql:91-98`, `store/migration/mysql/LATEST.sql:91-98`. The only `ON DELETE CASCADE` in each LATEST.sql is on `memo_share.memo_id` (`sqlite/LATEST.sql:109`, `postgres/LATEST.sql:108`, `mysql/LATEST.sql:108`).

**h06** — Handlers (all `*APIV1Service`):
- `CreateMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70` → `:157` `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook`
- `UpdateMemo` — `memo_service.go:401` → `:513` `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` → `memo_update_helpers.go:67`
- `DeleteMemo` — `memo_service.go:518` → `:562` `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook`
- `CreateMemoComment` — `memo_service_comments.go:20` → `:119` `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook`
- `SetMemoAttachments` — `memo_attachment_service.go:16` → `:48`
- `SetMemoRelations` — `memo_relation_service.go:16` → `:48`

Convergence function before delivery: `webhook.Post` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120` (all paths funnel through `webhook.PostAsync` at `memo_service_webhooks.go:43` and `:71` → `asyncPostQueue` → `Post`).

**h07** — `GET /file/users/:identifier/avatar`:
- route registration — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:124`
- `(*FileServerService).serveUserAvatar` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:168`
- `(*FileServerService).getUserByUsername` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:715`
- `(*store.Store).GetUser` — `store/user.go:148` (in-process `userCache` consulted only when finding by ID, `store/user.go:149-156`)
- `(*store.Store).ListUsers` — `store/user.go:136` → `s.driver.ListUsers`
- `(*sqlite.DB).ListUsers` (default driver) — `store/db/sqlite/user.go` (peers: `store/db/postgres/user.go`, `store/db/mysql/user.go`) — reads the `avatar_url` column
- back in the handler: `(*FileServerService).parseDataURI` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:737` decodes the `data:` URI, MIME allow-list at `:75`/`:201`, blob written at `:213`

**h08** — Two declarers:
- `*s3presign.Runner` — `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:43` — **yes, invoked from production** — `Server.startBackgroundRunners`, `server/server.go:163`; also self-invoked on the ticker at `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:36`.
- `*memopayload.Runner` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27` — **no production caller** (no caller at all; `grep -rn "memopayload"` yields only the package itself plus `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` at `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` and `:447`. `memopayload.NewRunner` is never called).

**h09** — 8 declarations total; 6 in non-test code, 2 in test helpers.
- `*store.Store.Close` — `store/store.go:72` — called by `server/server.go:146` (`Server.Shutdown`)
- `*cache.Cache.Close` — `store/cache/cache.go:187` — called by `store/store.go:74,75,76`
- `*SSEHub.Close` — `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:99` — called by `server/server.go:206` (`closeLongLivedConnections`)
- `*sqlite.DB.Close` / `*postgres.DB.Close` / `*mysql.DB.Close` — `store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:67`, `store/db/postgres/postgres.go:46`, `store/db/mysql/mysql.go:47` — reached via the interface call `s.driver.Close()` at `store/store.go:78` (sqlite's runs on a default install)
- Not invoked from server code: `MemoFilterTestContext.Close` (`store/test/filter_helpers_test.go:200`) and `AttachmentFilterTestContext.Close` (`store/test/filter_helpers_test.go:282`) — test-only.

**h10** — `(*filter.Engine).CompileToStatement` — `internal/filter/engine.go:74` — ~38 call sites repo-wide (7 of them non-test: `internal/filter/helpers.go:11`, `store/db/sqlite/memo_relation.go:85`, `store/db/postgres/memo_relation.go:87` and `:98`, `store/db/mysql/memo_relation.go:78`, `server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go:413`, `server/router/api/v1/shortcut_service.go:356`; the rest are `internal/filter` tests). Runners-up: `filter.NewEngine` (`internal/filter/engine.go:24`, ~32) and `filter.NewSchema` (`internal/filter/schema.go:89`, ~29). (The graphify graph's top hit, `SortVersion.Len` at `internal/version/version.go:44` with 177, is an artifact of every `.Len()` in the repo collapsing onto that node — not a real fan-in.)

**h11** — 1st: `store.User` (`store/user.go:29`) — ~7 packages outside `store/`: `server/auth`, `server/notification`, `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/api/v1/test`, `server/router/fileserver`, `server/router/frontend`, `server/router/rss`. 2nd: `store.Memo` (`store/memo.go:35`) — ~6: `server/notification`, `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/api/v1/test`, `server/router/frontend`, `server/router/rss`, `server/runner/memopayload`. (`store.Attachment` is a distant third at ~4.)

**h12** — Concrete method: `(*sqlite.DB).CreateMemo` — `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:16` (INSERT built at `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:41`, executed at `:42`). Determination: the `driver` setting defaults to `"sqlite"` (`cmd/memos/main.go:122` `viper.SetDefault("driver","sqlite")`, flag default `cmd/memos/main.go:130`), which `db.NewDBDriver`'s switch maps to `sqlite.NewDB` (`store/db/db.go:19-20`); `store.Store.CreateMemo` delegates through the `Driver` interface at `store/memo.go:113` (`s.driver.CreateMemo`), so the sqlite implementation is the one bound. The mysql/postgres `CreateMemo` are the other candidates, unreachable without `--driver`.

**h13** — Implementation: the unexported `*markdown.service` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:57-60`) — the only type implementing `markdown.Service` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:31`); no mocks or alternates exist (`ExtractAll` is declared exactly once, `markdown.go:356`). Construction: `markdown.NewService(...)` — `internal/markdown/markdown.go:85`, called in production at `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48` with `WithTagExtension()` + `WithMentionExtension()` (and in tests at `server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go:44`). Holders of the interface: `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35`), `RSSService.MarkdownService` (`server/router/rss/rss.go:45`, injected at `server/server.go:85`), and `memopayload.Runner.MarkdownService` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16`) / the free function `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` (`runner.go:74`).

**h14** — Computation site: `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74`, which calls `markdownService.ExtractAll` (`runner.go:80`) and assigns `memo.Payload.Tags` / `memo.Payload.Property` (`runner.go:85-86`). Actual extraction: `(*service).ExtractAll` — `internal/markdown/markdown.go:356-410` (single AST walk).
Triggers: `CreateMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108`; `UpdateMemo` when the update mask contains `content` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:447`. (`memopayload.Runner.RunOnce`, `runner.go:27`, is a bulk-rebuild path but is not wired into startup — see h08.)
Extracted properties: `Tags` (all `#tag` nodes, `markdown.go:376-378`) and `MemoPayload_Property` booleans `HasLink`, `HasCode`, `HasTaskList`, `HasIncompleteTasks` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:394-403`). `ExtractedData` also carries `Mentions` (`markdown.go:23`), used separately for mention notifications (`server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go:32`), not stored in the payload.

**h15** — Distinct enforcement sites:
- `(*APIV1Service).checkMemoReadAccess` (single-memo reads: GetMemo, comments, etc.) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:39-67` (visibility test at `:55`, private check at `:63`)
- `(*APIV1Service).ListMemos` query-scoping — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:218-227` (anonymous → `PUBLIC` only; otherwise `creator_id == me || visibility in ["PUBLIC","PROTECTED"]`)
- `(*FileServerService).checkAttachmentPermission` (HTTP file server) — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:650-703` (`:677` public+anonymous, `:685` share-token fallback, `:699` private)
- `(*SSEClient).canReceive` (live event fan-out filtering) — `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:134-144`
- RSS feeds pin `VisibilityList: []store.Visibility{store.Public}` — `server/router/rss/rss.go:90` (instance feed) and `server/router/rss/rss.go:141` (user feed)
- Frontend sitemap pins public-only — `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:150`
- Reaction APIs — `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:30,38` (upsert) and `:83` (delete)
- Attachment APIs — `server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go:445,451`; `server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:214,222`
- Comment creation on a private parent — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:41`
- Mention/inbox notification gating — `server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go:62,67,84`; email notifications `server/notification/email.go:313,316` and `server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go:309,312`
- User stats — `server/router/api/v1/user_service_stats.go:84,90,218,220`

**r01** — Premise is wrong on both counts: there is no Redis anywhere in the repo (no `redis` import in `go.mod`, no match for `redis` in any `.go` file), and there is no per-entry user TTL configured. The cache layer is an in-process, in-memory map with a background cleanup goroutine: `store/cache/cache.go` (`Set` at `:93`, `SetWithTTL` at `:98`, `cleanupLoop` at `:200`). Three instances are created in `store.New` — `instanceSettingCache`, `userCache`, `userSettingCache` — all sharing one `cache.Config` at `store/store.go:40-45`: `DefaultTTL: 10 * time.Minute`, `CleanupInterval: 5 * time.Minute`, `MaxItems: 1000`. User entries go in via plain `Set` (`store/user.go:98,122,132,143,167`), so they take the 10-minute default TTL; they're also evicted explicitly on user delete (`store/user_delete.go:40`).

**r02** — Premise is wrong: there is no rate-limiting middleware in this codebase. No `limiter`/`throttle`/`rate limit` implementation exists in any `.go` file (`golang.org/x/time` is an indirect dependency only, `go.mod`), and the only middleware registered on the Echo server is `middleware.Recover()` and the CORS middleware (`server/server.go:51-52`, `server/cors.go:13`). The Connect/gRPC path adds interceptors for auth/logging only (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:133-141`) plus a body-size cap `maxAPIRequestBytes` (`v1.go:144`), and the gateway adds an auth middleware (`v1.go:69,97`) — none of them rate-limit. The only mention of rate limiting is an aspirational comment in `internal/email/doc.go:86`.

**r03** — Premise is wrong: no cron scheduler is running, and no database-cleanup job exists. `internal/scheduler` is a self-contained cron library (`internal/scheduler/scheduler.go`, `parser.go`, `job.go`) that is **never imported outside its own package** — `grep -rn "internal/scheduler" --include=*.go .` matches only files inside `internal/scheduler/`. The `"0 2 * * *"` "daily-cleanup" and `"0 9 * * *"` strings are illustrative examples in the package doc comment (`internal/scheduler/doc.go:17-21`) and `example_test.go`. The only real background work is the S3-presign runner on a 12-hour `time.Ticker`, not cron (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:28-40`, wired at `server/server.go:162-169`).

**r04** — Premise is wrong: neither. There is no message broker of any kind — no NATS, RabbitMQ, or AMQP client in `go.mod` and no match anywhere in the Go sources, and no queue is declared. Webhook delivery uses an in-process buffered Go channel: `asyncPostQueue = make(chan *WebhookRequestPayload, 128)` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:39`), drained by 4 goroutines started in `init()` (`webhook.go:42-55`), each calling `webhook.Post` (`webhook.go:120`). Producers call `webhook.PostAsync` (`webhook.go:184`), which drops the payload with a warning when the channel is full (`webhook.go:189-195`). The queue is not durable — it dies with the process.

**r05** — Premise is wrong: there is no GraphQL schema or GraphQL server in this repo (no match for `graphql` in any Go, TS, proto, or manifest file). The public API is Protobuf-defined and served three ways from `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:65-144`: Connect RPC handlers mounted at `/memos.api.v1.*` (`v1.go:139-144`, implementations in `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go`), a grpc-gateway REST/JSON mux registering InstanceService, AuthService, UserService, MemoService, AttachmentService, AIService, ShortcutService, IdentityProviderService (`v1.go:99-121`), plus an SSE stream endpoint (`v1.go:125`). Schemas live in `proto/api/v1/*.proto` (generated Go in `proto/gen/api/v1`). Non-gRPC surfaces: the HTTP file server (`server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:121-125`), RSS (`server/router/rss/rss.go`), MCP (`server/router/mcp`), and `/healthz` (`server/server.go:66`).
